title: East Anglian Championships 2023
text: This year's East Anglian Championships are being hosted by SuffOC at their Tangham (Rendlesham Forest) event on 5th February. Clive Wilkinson, the organiser, has requested that all 2022 trophy holders please ensure that the engraved trophy is returned so that it can be presented to the 2023 winners on the day of the event. If you're unable to attend perhaps someone else in your club would be able to return it for you? Please contact Clive if there are any issues.
